effective_date_basis: Effective date of the revoking instrument per tract; or a current basis.
ending_pattern: Mineral withdrawals continue until revoked, modified or superseded by statute (the Mineral Leasing Act of 1920 changed disposal of these minerals but did not by itself revoke withdrawals). A modification that opens withdrawn lands to leasing does not end the withdrawal: it changes the disposal regime, and leases are accrued rights. Restoration orders end parts of earlier withdrawals.

exceptions_savings.assessment: Valid existing rights and leases. FLPMA (Pub. L. 94-579, Oct. 21, 1976) s.704(a) repealed the Pickett Act and implied withdrawal authority prospectively; s.701 saves existing withdrawals until modified under FLPMA or other law (IBLA, Grant L. Hacking, 1980). This is a continuity point, never an end; the s.204(l) review of withdrawals is a review lead, not an end.

legal_effect: Research pattern only. A type rule never fills a judgment field, establishes an end, a date, a status or savings for any order, and never substitutes for reading the order's own text.
outlier_conditions: The order's own text (not only the WPA summary or APP title) does not match the type, or the held text is another order's.
The order does more than the type's single act (a second operative clause of another kind).
A later order or statute amends, extends, revokes or revives it before the candidate end.
The order states its own effective date, duration, condition or termination that differs from the pattern.
Naval petroleum reserves, later governed by statute (independent basis).

The order only amends or modifies another order: its own operative effect merges into, and normally ends with, the parent order; read the parent's text and lifecycle. (The exemplar EO 6016 modifies EO 5327, the 1930 oil-shale withdrawal, to allow oil and gas leasing.)

Coal, phosphate or potash lands later restored subject to a mineral reservation under the surface-entry acts of 1909, 1910 and 1914: the restoration ends the withdrawal but leaves a reserved mineral estate.
Helium reserves governed by the Helium Act.
Oil-shale reserves later placed under statutory naval-reserve management.
